question.text: Four cells, each of emf $E$ and internal resistance $r,$ are connected in series across an external resistance $R .$ By mistake one of the cells is connected in reverse. Then the current in the external circuit is

solution.text: Total emf of the cell $=3 E-E=2 E$ Total internal resistance $=4 r$ $\therefore$ Total resistance of the circuit $=4 r+R$ So, the current in the external circuit $\left(\because i=\frac{V}{B}\right)$ $\therefore$ $$ i=\frac{2 E}{4 r+R} $$
